restrictions: Ordinary collision of SHA-256 reduced to 39 steps from the standard IV: two 128-byte messages with the same random first block M0 and second blocks M1, M1' = M1 + DL (differences in words 8..12), then the common padding block. The second block is the transplanted advice pair with A[6], A[7] released over a list generated at import by rule on the fibre h4 = 0x3cc9debe: 10,308,712 entries in 728 classes, 3,678,724 (a2, W10) keys; the walk constants c9, C9 are shifted by 0x05ceede0. The W17 condition is solved per F9 claw by a generic bit-sliced pass over the 65,000 distinct 18-bit prefixes (340 blocks); a passing prefix is completed, tested on scalar words and, at a key hit, expanded to the classes of its group.

Our accepted a26bcf74 (time 94.1664) with these changes: list re-based to 0x3cc9debe; walk table 92 x 1,024 slots (14,722 words); pass 159,753, setup 1,110,376,604 ops; K = 10,747 = ceil(602,826,339.6 / 56,096.96), C_W 56,096.96, 893.417 F9 claws per window (180-window screened 2^26 panel, seeds 827060-827239); trials per distinct claw 9605.1 = 9044.1 x 2^0.08096093 x (893.417/907.1667) x (57,003.18/56,096.96) under MODEL premise H1-fibre; divisor 1 - 0.081114 (mu_D 612,708 by the same ratio, MODEL; left-out union bound on the new key count); fibre selection 44,672,519,902 compressions charged next to 2^43 (H3-select MODEL: each build <= 2 x K4_SETUP). Kept: a3eb4a8a screen (S <= 5, KCAP 679, DTRY 8,192); tail 2^-74.3238 under H2-transfer; every key hit tested; second-order Bonferroni. Time 94.1340 (B = 2^76.424070 windows, ceiled at 4 decimals). Memory 1,043,785 B = 2^19.9934. Advice 160 bytes. Success 0.39.

heuristics.statement: MODEL (declared, new in this entry; point ratio). The trials per distinct claw on the 0x3cc9debe list under the screened law are 2^0.08096093 times those on the 0x3cc9eebe list, with the F9-claw factor D_L = 887.6572 (one-sided lower Student-t bound, 180 holdout windows 827060-827239) and the panel-mean denominator Cbar = 56,096.96 (J-159 two-factor form): T = A_L x r x D_L / Cbar = 573,886.10 x 2^0.08096093 x 887.6572 / 56,096.96 = 9605.14, priced 9605.1. The ratio is the pooled keys-with-an-F8-entry per F9 claw of the new list against the old on 16 fresh paired 2^22 windows with all 200 groups (winmeasure_rival.py, same seeds on both lists): 606,920.56 against 573,799.52 (D 219 against 204 claws), per-window mean +0.0729 bit with s.e. 0.0152. No 2,000-claw count and no confidence bound exist for the new list: the point ratio is carried as a model value.
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r39-prefix-v1 and the --attack path of experiments/r39joint_k4.py (screen on) with the shipped advice pair and the 0x3cc9debe list generated at import; the trial count 9605.1 of k4_budget.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 16 paired 2^22 windows (participant-run) to the 2^26 screened production law; the unscreened-to-screened step is H1-screen, kept from a26bcf74.
heuristics.limitations: A point estimate on 16 pairs at 2^22; the 2^22 panel does not by itself establish the 2^26 screened trial law of the new list; the within-claw co-hit measurements of H5 are of the old list.

heuristics.statement: MODEL (declared in ae2d3c1c, kept). Under the screened chaining-value and window law of the shipped program (a3eb4a8a screen S <= 5, KCAP = 679, DTRY = 8,192, KTRY = 32; windows of 2^26 walk evaluations): (i) distinct claws per window have mean 56,096.96, the unit C_W of B and the cap (the 180-window panel mean of Appendix C, seeds 827060-827239); (ii) the trials, distinct (a2, kappa) keys with at least one listed entry passing F8 in a claw passing F9, number at least 9605.1 per distinct claw (H1-fibre); (iii) kept chaining values are independent across windows; the (a0, a1) of the distinct F9 claws of a window are i.i.d., independent of the chaining value and of the number of claws, and a claw's trial-key count is a function of its (a0, a1) only (W8..W11 do not depend on the chaining value); the W17 claw constants (w, c) are uniform and independent of (a0, u), as H5 uses; at most 1,024 distinct F9 claws are evaluated per window (program cap). The anchor 9044.1 is the joint one-sided 99% lower bound (union bound, 99.5% per factor) (576,745.3 - 2.946713 x 970.3) x (907.1667 - 2.661759 x 25.6780 / sqrt(60)) / 57,003.18 = 9044.17 of a26bcf74: keys per F9 claw on 2,000 F9 claws of 0b62ed88's unscreened windows (16 batches, t(15)), distinct F9 claws per window on its 60 screened 2^26 windows, C_W as the declared model mean; the screen conditions the chaining value on S <= 5, and this premise carries the unscreened keys-per-F9-claw count to the screened law. The F9 claws per window and C_W of this entry are the new panel's (893.417, s.d. 29.679; 56,096.96).
heuristics.scope: The fixed target sha256-r39-prefix-v1 and the --attack path of experiments/r39joint_k4.py (screen on) with the shipped advice pair and the list generated at import.
heuristics.extrapolation: Paired participant-run probe of ae2d3c1c, same seeds on both builds, 16 pairs at 2^24 walk evaluations (N = F8-passing entries, K = distinct keys, over the four diagnostic groups, per distinct claw C): unscreened N/C 106.91, K/C 98.56; screened N/C 111.16, K/C 102.24; paired N/C change +0.0552 bit (s.e. 0.0459). The probe supports a nonnegative transfer; it is not a 2^26 panel of the key count: the transfer of the keys-per-F9-claw count is the declared premise.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run: 2,000 unscreened claws of the old list for the key count, 16 paired 2^24 windows for the screen transfer, 180 screened 2^26 windows of this program for C_W and the F9 claws per window.

heuristics.statement: The W17 pass costs exactly 159,753 operations per evaluated F9 claw: 733 + sum over the 200 groups of (110 + 403 x blocks), 340 blocks, a formula of the table evaluated and asserted by the program, with no folded or claw-specialised code. A survivor costs 711 + 563 per class tested, at most 5,215; a key hit at most 49,472 (the at most 8 classes of its group as mates); the screen 4 + 183 per first-block draw plus 3 per discarded draw; the one-time setup, the rule generator included, is charged 1,110,376,604 operations. K = 10,747 is the ceiling of the screened H6 mean-work bound 602,826,339.6 / 56,096.96 = 10,746.19; the import assertion also checks K >= 601,564,188 / 56,096.96 = 10,723.65, a panel-mean sanity check of the observed mean cost per claw, not a separate upper bound.
heuristics.scope: The counted pass, survivor, key-hit and screen paths and setup of experiments/r39joint_k4.py.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exact counts of the program; the organizer run asserts the pass cost per claw, planted survivor costs and, on one screened window, the screen charge of every draw (187 kept, 190 discarded).
heuristics.limitations: The 2^30 part of the setup is an allowance for the import's other statements.

heuristics.statement: MODEL (declared, favorable; kept from ae2d3c1c, re-scoped to the fibre 0x3cc9debe). For the designated (lowest-a3) F8-passing mate of a trial key drawn uniformly over all trial (window, claw, key) triples of the attack, windows drawn under the screened chaining-value law (a3eb4a8a screen, S <= 5) and weighted by their trial count, of the fibre 0x3cc9debe, in a claw passing F9 with W17 equal to the advice value (an entry the program compresses at every hit of that key), the two 39-step compressions give equal outputs with probability at least 2^-74.3238, the linear mean of the 14 organizer-executed runs r39-tail-01..14 of the shipped replica (hard-asserted), which sample the advice draws, carried to the new fibre. No tail arm was run on 0x3cc9debe. The nearest evidence is the 0x3cc9eebe arms of 0b62ed88 (participant-run, 28 organizer-protocol runs each): key-weighted arm K mean 2^-74.3734 (s.e. 0.0364; weighted by window size 2^-74.3747, one-sided 99.9% bound 2^-74.5058), R 3cc9eebe mean 2^-74.3781 (s.e. 0.0289, 99.9% bound 2^-74.4804), paired against h0 variants log2 ratio -0.014 (s.e. 0.023); the two fibres differ by two bits of h4 (bits 12 and 13; 0x...eebe against 0x...debe, modular difference 0x1000) and share the trail, the walk map and the tail replica. Model, stated plainly: the SMC carrier sees a window only through its claws' (a0, a1); the replica's check value QDECL = -74.54 lies below its hard-asserted one-sided 99.9% bound 2^-74.4326.
heuristics.scope: Rows 18 to 38 of the advice trail after rows 0 to 17 hold, for trial keys of windows of the screened law on the 0x3cc9debe list; parity classes pooled as in 5f8e6192.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the organizer replica (advice draws) and the 0x3cc9eebe arms to the designated mates of the 0x3cc9debe list; every arm hit was verified by recompressing both blocks. The arms are participant-run; the organizer's replica samples the advice distribution.
heuristics.limitations: The transfer to 0x3cc9debe is declared, with no direct arm on that fibre; the 0x3cc9eebe arms lie about 0.05 bit below the priced value; the attack's trials are all of class 01 (a0 even, W1 odd), whose paired figure on 0x3cc9eebe is -0.021; pricing at QDECL = -74.54 would add 0.2162 bit; the arms' claws are of unscreened windows.

heuristics.statement: A[8..11], E[12..15] and W12..W15 are fixed to the advice values; (A[6], A[7]) range over the listed entries of the fibre 0x3cc9debe; for every listed entry both messages follow the advice state-difference trail through step 15, W9 is C9 + 0x05ceede0 - a1 and W16 is one value per claw. Constructing and selecting the advice pair costs at most 2^43 compressions (2^42.545 by the accounting of proof Section 9), and the fibre selection 56,566 list builds, each charged twice the shipped list's counted generator cost (H3-select, MODEL), 44,672,519,902 compressions; both are added to the claimed time as preprocessing_log2 = 43.0074.
heuristics.scope: The one-time construction of the 160-byte advice pair of 5f8e6192; the list is generated at import by the rule of proof Section 2.5; the fibre selection among candidate lists.
heuristics.extrapolation: Exhaustive enumeration over all 2^32 a3 with the real two-message trail checked on every entry at four points (0 failures) on the 0x3cc9eebe list; the rule reproduces that list exactly; the same rule and generator produce the 0x3cc9debe list, whose counts the program asserts at import and whose sample entries the organizer run checks (one entry of every group at the advice point, 200 of 200).
heuristics.limitations: The 93-pair campaign was run by the pair's authors and is charged at its declared cost; the exhaustive enum15 cross-check is of the 0x3cc9eebe list (the organizer run checks one entry per group of the new list).

heuristics.statement: Screened-window scope on the 0x3cc9debe list: windows are independent (fresh first blocks, each drawn and screened independently). Trials are distinct (a2, kappa) keys with at least one listed entry passing F8 in a claw passing F9: at least 9605.1 per distinct claw (H1-fibre, H1-screen). Each listed key's W17 event has probability 2^-32 in each claw (a uniform claw constant); events in different claws are independent. Within a claw, two keys hit together iff G(a2, kappa, w) = s0(a2 + w) - (a2 + w) + kappa coincide. The within-claw co-hit bound pi_max = 1.36e-2 (family-wise E[min(N_k, 3)] over all 3,462,264 keys of the 0x3cc9eebe list, two sets of 16,384 random w) is carried to the 3,678,724-key list by declaration (H5-fibre; not re-measured, OPEN); the left-out term is re-formed on the new key count, P(N_k >= 4) <= ln(3,678,724 / 0.001) / 16,384 = 1.34435e-3 (the union-bound form, assuming the no-N >= 4 observation transfers). The cross-claw term uses mu_D = 579,271 x 2^0.08096093 = 612,708, the old list's 99% bound of keys per F9 claw raised by the H1-fibre ratio (a MODEL value, not a bound): 2^-32 x 1,023 x 612,708 / 2 = 0.0729692, so the divisor is 1 - 0.0729692 - 0.006800 - 0.00134435 = 0.9188865, priced 1 - 0.081114. Success is priced by second-order Bonferroni over all hits on designated-mate events (proof Section 7) with the cross-claw term bounded through the cap of 1,024 claws for any correlation; no premise between the tails of different hits is used.
heuristics.scope: The amplification over 2^76.424070 windows of the screened program on the 0x3cc9debe list.
heuristics.extrapolation: Keys with an entry in F8 per F9 claw: 576,745.3 (s.e. 970.3, 2,000 claws of the old list) times the H1-fibre ratio; F9 claws per window from the 180 pre-declared holdout windows (mean 893.417, s.d. 29.679); mu_D by the same ratio.
heuristics.limitations: Participant-run counts of the old list; the co-hit and mu_D bounds are not re-measured on the new list; the organizer's dispersion test is a scaled spot test on four fixed groups; independence of the 2^-32 events over all groups and windows is the premise, not a measurement.

heuristics.statement: Screened whole-window bound of this program. Under the H6 model (screened window totals i.i.d. over windows; normal-theory Student-t and chi-square bounds for their mean and s.d.), mean work per window of the shipped attack path is at most 602,826,339.6 operations (one-sided 99.75%, t(179) = 2.8422 on 180 windows: mean 601,564,187.8, s.d. 5,957,795.7) against the cap 10,747 x 56,096.96 = 602,874,029.12 (margin 47,689.52 operations), and the per-window s.d. is at most 6,978,853 (sigma_U = s_U x sqrt(179 / chi-square(179, 0.0025)), chi-square(179, 0.0025) = 130.4536; chi-square(179, 0.0025) = 130.4536, sigma_U = 6,978,853) (one-sided 99.75%, chi-square(179, 0.0025) (= 130.4536)); jointly 99.5%. A window total is the shipped counter over the whole window, so component covariance and every online screen charge (4 + 183 per draw, 3 per discard) are inside it. These are bounds on the mean and s.d., not a maximum over windows. For independent windows Chebyshev bounds the probability that the cap binds before B windows by 2.1e-19 with the bounded s.d. (1.54e-19 with the sample s.d.; B = 101,376,566,856,620,206,718,977).
heuristics.scope: The work cap of k4_budget for the screened program with the 0x3cc9debe list and the 92 x 1,024 table.
heuristics.extrapolation: From 180 pre-declared screened full windows (seeds 827060-827239, 2^26 walk evaluations, all present) of the shipped attack path.
heuristics.limitations: Model-based bounds on the sample moments under the stated window-distribution model.

heuristics.statement: Given the claws, the W17 events of distinct keys are dispersed as independent trials. Tested in the organizer run at a scaled event of probability 2^-7 on every key of four groups (every 50th) with an entry in F8, in every F9 claw of the four organizer windows: 117,092 key events, 940 hits against 914.8 expected (z = +0.83), Pearson 12.55 on 16 claws; acceptance region fixed in the manifest and asserted (sum D >= 96,821; (sum K - sum D/128)^2 < 6.58 x sum D/128; Pearson < 40.29).
heuristics.scope: Four of the 200 groups, all F9 claws of the four organizer windows of r39k4-window-small.
heuristics.extrapolation: The attack's event has probability 2^-32 on the same keys and words.
heuristics.limitations: Four groups only, for run time; the groups are fixed by the program.
